test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is closest in meaning to the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

Losing my job was __a blessing in disguise__ because I got to spend more time with my family.

options.text: task that appeared difficult at first but became easy later
a joyful event that made everybody happy
event that seemed bad at first but resulted in something good later
a good thing that happened only once

solution:
The correct answer is 'event that seemed bad at first but resulted in something good later'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to explore the meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence in this question.
 
• A blessing in disguise : an apparent misfortune that eventually has good results.
 
 
• ​Example: Losing that hectic job was a blessing in disguise.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, from the given idiom meaning and the example sentence , we are clear that it means 'event that seemed bad at first but resulted in something good later'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
